event_summary: A green sheet between two scissor-like tools visibly splits into two separate green pieces.
raw_event_description: At the start, a bright green rectangular sheet spans horizontally across a wooden tabletop between two black-and-blue scissor-like tools. For several moments the sheet appears intact and nearly still. A split then appears near the center of the sheet, the two green portions lift and curve into different shapes, and the gap between them grows. By the end, two separate green pieces are visible on the tabletop area, one toward the left tool and one toward the right tool.

reasons: The green sheet is fully visible across the center of the frame.
Both scissor-like tools are visible at the left and right edges.
The tabletop and background are visible.
